summary: Ansible uses native OpenSSH by default for ControlPersist, Kerberos and ~/.ssh/config options like jump hosts, falling back to paramiko when OpenSSH is too old for ControlPersist.
questions: Why does Ansible use paramiko instead of OpenSSH?
What is ControlPersist used for in Ansible?

answer_card.title: OpenSSH vs paramiko
answer_card.answer_md: By default Ansible uses native OpenSSH, which supports ControlPersist (faster repeated connections), Kerberos, and `~/.ssh/config` options such as jump hosts. If your control node's OpenSSH is too old for ControlPersist, Ansible falls back to **paramiko**, a Python SSH implementation.
